profile_text.body:
Boston Dynamics describes itself as a leading global robotics company that builds practical robotics to tackle automation challenges. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, United States. It operates as a for-profit public company.

Its own site highlights Stretch, a robot it presents as easy to deploy and flexible, used to streamline case handling and warehouse automation. The site also offers white papers and eBooks covering the development, implementation, and value of robots and automation solutions.

No litigation cases are listed for the company. Its recorded law exposure is in Massachusetts, with a count of 184. No MCP servers are listed for it.
